findings.description: Displayed table results largely recur in direct R translations. Survey 1 rank tests and regression outputs depend on missingness and a Stata/R variance or test convention; Survey 2 control regressions were made to retain N=6,243 by coding unclassified postal leading digits as all-zero state indicators, matching Stata logical comparisons.
findings.evidence: Translated run log records means and Ns; the supplied Stata scripts use Stata ranksum/reg robust. The primary data files are anonymized/analysis-ready; data cleaning from original waves is not run because those inputs are not shipped.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide machine-readable exact published output and a Stata execution environment, or report test/model conventions fully.

limitations: Results are direct R translations because Stata is unavailable; R wilcox.test and robust covariance details may differ from Stata.
Primary Survey 1 master data are shipped; its upstream cleaning script requires confidential GIP source waves not present in the package.
Individual binomial and KS test outputs were described but were not extracted into individual numeric result records; appendix-only exhibits are outside the article body/table scope.
No existing reproduction reports were consulted.
